stages.title: SUBORDINATE ENRICHMENT — ONLY AFTER THE COMPLETE CORE

pills.text: A PROCUREMENT RULE CAN ENCOURAGE LOCALISATION BUT CANNOT ITSELF
WITHOUT REGULAR ORDERS, DOMESTIC FIRMS CANNOT AMORTISE CAPITAL INVESTMENT
EXPORT COMPETITIVENESS REQUIRES QUALITY, CERTIFICATION CREDIBILITY, AFTER-SALES SUPPORT AND
DIPLOMATIC-MARKET ACCESS, NOT JUST A DOMESTIC “MAKE IN INDIA”
THE HARDEST STEP IS OFTEN FROM PROTOTYPE OR LIMITED-SERIES

groups.heading: OPTIONAL SCIENTIFIC / ENGINEERING DEPTH
items: CAUTION: A procurement rule can encourage localisation but cannot itself create deep technology absorption.
CAUTION: Scale matters: without regular orders, domestic firms cannot amortise capital investment or build supplier confidence.
CAUTION: Export competitiveness requires quality, certification credibility, after-sales support and
diplomatic-market access, not just a domestic “Make in India” slogan.

groups.heading: READINESS, UNIT OR STATUS LIMIT
items: CAUTION: The hardest step is often from prototype or limited-series production to reliable, repeatable industrial throughput.
Department of Defence Production: central administrative anchor for production and DPSUs — distinct from the Department
of Defence R&D/DRDO (technology creation) and from the Defence Acquisition Council (approval of necessity and categorisation).
DAP 2020: formal acquisition rulebook.

groups.heading: COMPARATIVE TECHNOLOGY / GOVERNANCE NUANCE
items: Defence Innovation Organisation — iDEX and ADITI: startup/MSME innovation channel
Technology Development Fund (DRDO): industry-led development funding.
SRIJAN: public-facing implementation dashboard for positive-indigenisation items.
DPSU product filters on official DDP page: HAL, BEL, BDL, MDL, GRSE and GSL are visible categories
